description: Two-signal, FP-tight detector for conservation surfaces the attack-surface scorer under-weights: (shape 1) multi-term supply/balance aggregates with a balanceOf/totalSupply or supply-named term -> double-count risk (Blackhole M-01); (shape 2) product/invariant helpers with integer division -> floor-to-zero rounding risk (Blackhole M-06). Advisory only (is_gate=false); routes high/medium of its own hits via advisory_escalation_gate, never mints findings.
notes: Shape 2 is intentionally looser and overlaps math_estimator; the audit downgrades a shape-2 hit to context_only (tag dedup_math_estimator) when math_estimator_audit.json already flags the same manifest_id. Route-rate is capped well under noise_audit's 0.50 by the two-signal gate.
